raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 10, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the confirmed death dates—Edwin L. Marin (1951) and Maurice Elvey (1967)—and incorrectly concluded that The Death Kiss’s director died later, despite evidence showing Maurice Elvey (Her Luck in London) died later.
